title: Brackenlow's Bottomless Stew
story: Brackenlow the Swamp Cook refuses to release the ferry passengers until his stew is perfect, and his recipe demands moss and mudroot in a strict ratio of 5 to 3. He has already dumped in 45 handfuls of moss and is now cackling about how nobody can figure out the rest.
question: How many handfuls of mudroot are needed to match 45 handfuls of moss at a ratio of 5 to 3?
hint: How many groups of 5 moss are in 45? Each of those groups needs 3 mudroot.
victory: Mr 6 measured 27 handfuls exactly, and Brackenlow tasted the stew, burst into happy tears, and ferried everyone across for free with seconds.
imagePrompt: A big-bellied swamp cook stirring an enormous bubbling cauldron on a misty bog dock, glowing green steam rising, while a numeral-six knight balances handfuls of moss and mudroot.
solution: So 27 handfuls of mudroot are needed.
praise: Thinking in ratio groups was a strong strategy — the missing step was multiplying those 9 groups by 3.
